prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE single wide 16:9 opaque raster environment plate, native1672 by941 pixels, for a 2D side-view fighting arena. The supplied primary image is a native gameplay screenshot from Silent Hill: Shattered Memories, Wii promotional gallery dated31July2009. It depicts an UNNAMED FROZEN EXTERIOR NIGHTMARE ROUTE: thick gray-blue ice walls, fragments of ordinary brick building surfaces and ledges embedded in that ice, a bent slender bare utility pole, a dark open gap between upper broken masonry and the lower ice bank, and a dull frozen surface. Preserve these distinctive materials and modest town-building scale. Remove Harry at the left, the pale creature, reticle and every human or creature entirely. This is not the ordinary snow-covered streets phase; do not turn it into a Christmas village, snowy town square or forest. Do not invent a street name or storefront brand.\n\nRecompose the observed exterior route into a simple side-on arena at standing eye height with shallow perspective. A continuous cold slate ground strip occupies the lower28percent, with a straight level fighter footing at normalizedy=0.87. Source terrain slopes and pits must be absent from the playable foreground because this is an authored versus adaptation. The central86percent must have no obstacles or occlusion: no pillar, car, railing, fence, rubble pile, sheer drop or tall ice across the fighting plane. Keep the giant frozen banks, broken embedded gray brick and cracked plaster ABOVE and BEHIND that fighting plane, without overhanging opaque ice in front of fighters. A thin bent pole with a few bare wires remains in the rear plane, offset toward one side. Unseen architectural depth should remain obscured by source-like darkness. Desaturated charcoal, slate blue and pale ice; rough natural opaque/translucent frozen surfaces with sparse cyan glints. Avoid glowing magic, blue crystal fantasy caves, symmetric temple shapes, distant cathedral, fire, red stains, storm snow, neon and excess props. No readable lettering, figures, bodies, HUD, text, watermark, montage or frame borders. One empty coherent background plate. The scene is source-guided from a promotional image: the expanded camera and level ground are adaptations, not claims of final-game1:1 geometry.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE independent native1672x941 wide16:9 RGBA foreground overlay with a truly transparent background. Image1 is only a supporting style and material reference, NOT a backdrop to copy. Output only two tiny cropped near-edge slivers of dark blue-gray fractured ice fused to ordinary gray masonry, matching that frozen exterior street plate. Keep these details strictly within the outermost5percent of the left and right sides. They may cling to the upper corners and the very outer lower corners. Every pixel in the central86percent of the image must be completely transparent, alpha0, from top to bottom. No floor strip, no transparent color wash, no mist, no vignette, no opaque black backdrop, no central object or shadow. At least94percent of the full canvas remains transparent. The source's fractured ice is dull slate and charcoal with restrained gray-cyan frosted edges, not clear glowing fantasy crystal. Do NOT repeat the large background wall, pole, wires, building, floor, horizon or sky. Keep the fragments exceptionally sparse and unobtrusive, cropped by the canvas boundary and facing the same side-on camera. No text, labels, logos, people, bodies, monsters, watermark or UI. This is a sparse near parallax overlay only, with all central fighting space clear.
